sources: Data Product Lines & Data Portfolio slide (Commercial / Midstream / Corporate)
Commercial Business Process Lifecycle slide (Rack Pricing, Loss Control additions)
notes: Blue rectangles on the source slide = Data Product Lines (containers); boxes inside = Data Portfolios (data products).
Engagement/project-management coverage tags are intentionally excluded from this model.
Handbook synonym: a Data Portfolio item here corresponds to an entry in the handbook's Data Product Portfolio workstream.
Foundational vs derived classification per handbook can be added per portfolio later.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Commercial hydrocarbon data domains: trading, marketing & sales, market structure & logistics, planning & optimization.

productLines.name: Energy Trading & Risk Management
productLines.description: Data products supporting physical/financial trading and commercial risk management (ETRM domain).

portfolios.name: Commercial Risk
portfolios.description: Commodity trading risk data: positions, exposures, P&L, VaR, limits, counterparty credit in the trading context. Distinct from Order-to-Cash customer AR credit.

portfolios.name: Physical Trading
portfolios.description: Deal/trade facts for physical commodity transactions: trade capture, contracts, positions, movements context.

portfolios.name: Quality Assurance
portfolios.description: Product/crude quality data: assays, lab results, specifications, blending quality outcomes.

productLines.name: Marketing & Sales
productLines.description: Customer-facing marketing and sales data products.

portfolios.name: Brand Data & Integration
portfolios.description: Brand, branded-site, and brand-partner data integration.

portfolios.name: Retail Payments
portfolios.description: Retail transaction and payment data captured at branded retail sites (tender, cards, loyalty-linked payment).

portfolios.name: Product Availability & Allocations
portfolios.description: Product avails and allocation decisions data supporting order validation and channel supply.

productLines.name: Market Structure & Logistics Management
productLines.description: Pricing structures, logistics execution, margin and external market data products.

portfolios.name: Master Pricing
portfolios.description: Validated price system of record: official product prices derived from market data and internal assessment.

portfolios.name: Rack Pricing
portfolios.description: Wholesale rack price data: calculated, approved, published rack prices per sales cycle. Distinct portfolio from Master Pricing.
notes: Product line placement provisional; confirm with data owners.

portfolios.name: Logistic Execution
portfolios.description: Nominations, scheduling, and physical movement execution data (pipeline, marine, rail, truck from the commercial view).

portfolios.name: Loss Control
portfolios.description: Custody transfer, gain/loss, and shrinkage data across movements and terminal operations.
notes: Product line placement provisional; confirm with data owners.

portfolios.name: Operational Margin
portfolios.description: Margin measurement data across commercial operations (supply, logistics, channel).

portfolios.name: External Market Data
portfolios.description: Third-party market feeds: price assessments, indices, market intelligence inputs.

productLines.name: Planning & Optimization
productLines.description: Value chain planning and optimization data products. Referenced on lifecycle slides by shorthand 'P&O' (a product line, not a portfolio item).

portfolios.name: Regional Production & Distribution Planning
portfolios.description: Regional optimization and distribution planning data.

portfolios.name: Local Production Planning & Crude Scheduling
portfolios.description: Refinery/local production planning and crude scheduling data.

portfolios.name: Backcasting & Refining Continuous Improvement
portfolios.description: Backcast results vs plan/perfect-foresight, value leakage, and continuous improvement data.

segments.name: Midstream
segments.description: Midstream operations data domains. Process decomposition for Midstream does not yet exist in the LSC map (L1 stub); portfolios are cataloged here and remain unlinked until a midstream process source is modeled.

productLines.name: Infrastructure Platforms
notes: Platform product line; not expected to map to business process nodes.

productLines.name: Software Development Platforms
notes: Platform product line; not expected to map to business process nodes.

portfolios.name: Quality Assurance (Software)
notes: Software QA; distinct from Commercial product Quality Assurance (dp-quality-assurance).

segments.name: Corporate
segments.description: Corporate/enabling function data domains. Maps loosely to the Enabling Functions L0 in the LSC map (all L1 stubs).

portfolios.name: ES&S
notes: Closest LSC anchor: Enabling Functions > EHS & Gov Reporting (stub).

portfolios.name: Legal
notes: Closest LSC anchor: Enabling Functions > Legal & Corp Comm (stub).

portfolios.name: BP&A
notes: Closest LSC anchor: Enabling Functions > Finance (stub).

portfolios.name: SC

portfolios.name: IT
